title: Boundaries of logarithmic Voronoi cells can be transcendental
summary: We show that logarithmic Voronoi boundaries for one-dimensional algebraic models in the probability simplex need not be algebraic. We give two explicit examples. For a union of two lines, the logarithmic Voronoi cell at a specific smooth rational point has a transcendental boundary point. For a cuspidal curve, the cell at the singular point contains a non-algebraic real-analytic boundary branch.
